title: 9 metre hologram goes on display in Oz

posts.topic_title: 9 metre hologram goes on display in Oz
posts.author: zipsister
posts.post_subject: 9 metre hologram goes on display in Oz
posts.content_md:
My 9 metre hologram, I Dreamt We Had Soemthing To Say, along with a couple of metre square stereograms made at Holographics North and some pulse reflections made in Russia at holography.ru will go on display at the Canberra Museum and Gallery, Australia for four month from July to October as part of the inaugural National Photography Festival in Canberra. When they're up and running I'll post images on my website.

zipsister

posts.author: zipsister
posts.post_subject: 9 metre hologram goes on display in Oz
posts.content_md:
Hi Colin/John,

It will go on display at the Canberra Museum and Gallery, [www.museumsandgalleries.act.gov.au](http://www.museumsandgalleries.act.gov.au) from 21June-12 October along with the metre square stereograms made at HoloNorth and some holograms made at Holography.ru in Russia. I'm also working on a project for a 20 metres x 2metres x 0.5metre holographic work comprising 1000 holograms at Canberra International Airport's soon to be built extension to their passenger terminal.

zipsister
